title: Maximum Height by Stacking Cuboids
goal: Stack rotatable cuboids for maximum total height while respecting all three dimension limits.
strategy: Sort each cuboid dimensions so its largest dimension becomes height, then order cuboids. Dynamic programming tries every compatible smaller stack above each candidate base.
